name: Sheathed Trol'kalar
summary: Trol'kalar lies freed within its stone sheath in Arathi Highlands. Zengu at Hammerfall awaits the sword, prized by the Darkspear trolls.

sections.title: The Stone Sheath
sections.body: From Trollbane's Tomb in Arathi Highlands, you carry Trol'kalar within its stone sheath. The light that held the sword fades, freeing the weapon. Zengu waits at Hammerfall to receive it.

faq.answer: Sheathed Trol'kalar holds the sword Trol'kalar within a stone sheath. The fading light releases the weapon.
You find Sheathed Trol'kalar in Trollbane's Tomb in Arathi Highlands.
Zengu at Hammerfall awaits Trol'kalar. He says it will be delivered to Nimboya at Grom'gol.

faq.q: Why does Trol'kalar matter to the trolls?
faq.answer: Trol'kalar is called the greatest weapon of Strom and Arathor. Zengu says the Darkspear trolls are indebted to you for returning it.

angles.text: As a troll, you carry a weapon Zengu calls the greatest of Strom and Arathor. The Darkspear are indebted to you for returning it.
